Seven Wonders Luxury Camp, Petra, Jordan.
Seven Wonders Luxury Camp, Petra, Jordan. Seven Wonders Luxury Camp, Petra, Jordan. Seven Wonders Luxury Camp, Petra, Jordan.
Our luxury dome tents and cabins are close to the Petra Visitors Centre - just a 12 minutes drive.
Mobile: 00962 7 9694 1865
Why stay at the Seven Wonders Luxury Camp, PETRA?
WE PUT A LITTLE COMFORT INTO CAMPING
Just a 12 minute drive from the Petra Visitor's Centre, the Seven Wonders Luxury Camp is nestled in the beautiful landscape of Little Petra. We offer you the choice of a Dome Tent or a Cabin.
To feel close to nature, you usually have to pitch your tent and sleep in a sleeping bag. Well, we have made things a little easier - you can come and sleep in this extraordinary desert landscape and still enjoy a soft bed, clean sheets, A/C, and an ensuite bathroom.
We will even feed you. Buffet breakfasts and dinners are served in our on-site restaurant and soft drinks, tea, coffee and shisha are available in our coffee shop. What could be better!
Domes, Cabins and Prices
PETRA - AND A LITTLE BIT MORE
Our luxury camp is a great base for visiting the main site of Petra. But, there is more.
It is only a 20 minute walk from the Seven Wonders Luxury Camp to the Little Petra Site and to the beginning of the Back Way Hike to the Monastery in Petra. Jeep transfers are available so that the hike is just over 1 hr or we can provide a guide and you can walk the entire way (just over2hrs).
You can also explore the area on horses or do a longer ride or hike up to Mt. Haroun.
Activities
OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU
We will look after you. Whether you sleep in a luxury martian dome tent or in a comfortable cabin, we are committed to excellence and providing you with a unique experience and a life-long memory. No need to stay in a hotel while you visit Petra - come and stay with us at the Seven Wonders Luxury Camp in Little Petra.
Spacious Reception
TRADITIONAL BEDOUIN TENT FOR TEA, COFFEE, SOFT DRINKS AND SHISHA.
Large and Airy Restaurant
The Reception is large with lots of seating. You don't feel cramped when you check in.
Large and Airy Restaurant
TRADITIONAL BEDOUIN TENT FOR TEA, COFFEE, SOFT DRINKS AND SHISHA.
Large and Airy Restaurant
The Restaurant is large and the tables spaced out. Social distancing is easy.
Contact Us
TRADITIONAL BEDOUIN TENT FOR TEA, COFFEE, SOFT DRINKS AND SHISHA.
TRADITIONAL BEDOUIN TENT FOR TEA, COFFEE, SOFT DRINKS AND SHISHA.
TRADITIONAL BEDOUIN TENT FOR TEA, COFFEE, SOFT DRINKS AND SHISHA.
At night, the Bedouin Tent Coffee Shop is available for tea, coffee, soft drinks and shisha. We do not sell alcohol, but you are welcome to bring your own.
Meet the Team
Atef Mashaileh and Hashem Mashaileh own and manage both the Seven Wonders Luxury Camp and the Seven Wonders Bedouin Camp. They are bedouins from this area. They and their families have been running the Seven Wonders Bedouin Camp since 2010 - and both camps are very much a family business.
In 2018, they built the Seven Wonders Luxury Camp. The Luxury Camp is really enjoyable for travellers not used to camping out.
Being outside and welcoming guests is a central part of the bedouin tradition and they love sharing both their camps with visitors.
AHLAN WA SAHLAN - WELCOME

CAMP LOCATION
If you are driving your own vehicle, we have parking beside the camp. You do not need a 4x4.
If you have Google Maps please type in as the destination Seven Wonders Luxury Camp or use the coordinates 30.373905 35.458670 . BOTH WILL TAKE YOU TO THE BEGINNING OF OUR DRIVEWAY.
We are about 15 mins out of Petra, in Little Petra. If you are driving you follow the road down through Wadi Musa township to the Petra Visitors Centre at the bottom and then keep going around a sharp right hand turn by the Movenpick Hotel (which is on the corner opposite the Petra Visitors Centre). You then drive up the road (you will pass the Museum on your left hand side) and then turn left at the T-Junction at the end - you are now heading out to Little Petra.
After about 5 mins you will drive through a small village. Keep going. After about another 5 mins you will drive past a camp on the right hand side of the road (Little Petra Bedouin Camp) and then you will drive up and over a small hill - our driveway entrance is on the right, at the bottom of the hill. There is a sign for us AND a sign for the Seven Wonders Bedouin Camp (we share same driveway).
